- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided tips for making homemade tortillas from scratch, including:
  1. Use the right type of flour (masa harina)
  2. Use warm water
  3. Mix the dough just right
  4. Knead the dough
  5. Let the dough rest
  6. Use a cast-iron skillet or comal
  7. Roll out the dough thinly
  8. Cook the tortillas at the right temperature
